title: Research: seed-7 H2-sem matching dominates #1805 F/ADD invoice
body:
## Change and scope

Answers open question 1 of [#1805](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1805): under the H2-sem replacement interface, can a different disjoint helper-sharing matching lower forward envelope `F` while keeping most of the ADD saving?

Yes. The same PR848 ADD-greedy rule with shuffle seed **7** (instead of the published seed **42**) produces a disjoint matching that **strictly dominates** the #1805 seed-42 invoice on ADD count (−14), `F` (−1,576), and `B` (−8,612). Paid profile mass **5,129** is unchanged; dirty F2 boundaries and semantic `N` are unchanged; local/nine-stage guards remain strict. Package is freestanding (`research/h2sem-matching-f-invoice/`) and does not reopen #1805 / #2033 objects.

**Priced finite invoice; no new kappa.**

## Result

| word | pairs | ADDs | F | B |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| seed-42 matching (#1805) | 205 | 18,074 | 75,381 | 1,196,402 |
| **seed-7 matching (this)** | **208** | **18,060** | **73,805** | **1,187,790** |
| seed-7 minus seed-42 | +3 | **−14** | **−1,576** | −8,612 |

A bounded ADD-greedy shuffle screen over seeds `0..255` found no point that beats seed-7 on both ADD saving and `F` simultaneously (not a claim of optimality outside that screen).

Package: `research/h2sem-matching-f-invoice/`.
Tip: `2f79aebb959aa9e528c5c7d5f1314b685190e11f`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/h2sem-matching-f-invoice/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/h2sem-matching-f-invoice/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/h2sem-matching-f-invoice/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/h2sem-matching-f-invoice
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_H2SEM_MATCHING_F_INVOICE seed42_pairs=205 adds=24305->18074 F=75381 seed7_pairs=208 adds=24305->18060 F=73805 delta_adds=-14 delta_F=-1576 profile_mass=5129 columns=661 controls=7 no_new_kappa
PASS_H2SEM_MATCHING_F_INVOICE_PACKAGE_CONTROLS relocation=1 corruptions=5
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/h2sem-matching-f-invoice outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` (not `assert`); `-O` also passes. Full `make verify`, selected cold replay, Lean, and multiplication-theorem obligations were not rerun for this isolated invoice package.

## Overlap and credit

Closest prior: [#1805](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1805) seed-42 priced invoice (OQ1 open; this answers it with a full re-invoice; #1805 is now merged). [#2033](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2033) already answers #1805 OQ2 and is left alone. Leave-alone tooling through [#2433](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2433) was not reopened. No competing open PR on this freestanding matching-F invoice package at refresh.

Credit the #1805 / PR848 / H2-sem lineage. Prepared by Wentao Li ([VictorLiwentao](https://github.com/VictorLiwentao), [@Is__Victor](https://x.com/Is__Victor)) with substantial AI assistance, under Apache-2.0.
